description:
The optional body of `POST /plans/{id}/apply` (contract 1.29). dek sends
one only when it has something to ask; without a body the apply is as
before.

min_approvals.description:
The approvals each level of the plan's review must need at least,
asked for by the capability's approval class. A request only: the
core enforces it, and refuses the apply when it cannot (a class it
does not know or does not review, more than its deciders can give,
outside 1 to [`MAX_LEVEL_APPROVALS`](crate::MAX_LEVEL_APPROVALS)).

title: ApplyRequest
